newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn seen commenting on forex at 1230gmt news conf.
newsitem.headline: Bonn seen commenting on forex at 1230gmt news conf.

text.p: The German government is likely to comment on developments on foreign exchange markets at its regular news conference at 1230 GMT, government sources said on Wednesday.

The sources said it was not expected that the cabinet, which began meeting at 0730 GMT, would make a formal statement of its own but that Finance Minister Theo Waigel would discuss the issues in cabinet.
"No formal statement is expected," one government source told Reuters.
Waigel said on Tuesday that the cabinet would make a statement about current developments on foreign exchange markets.
He made the statement after he told reporters in Berlin that the current strength of the dollar and sterling against the mark reflected an overreaction by financial markets.
